      Key
      what each mark means, and how to move around
      
    
      
      
      
      
      Color who it belongs to
      
        
      Lavender
      Psyche, the ward, and what Psyche sends
      
        
      Near-white
      Waiting on you
      
        
      Coral
      A resource limit is near or the mission was kept stopped at a limit
      
        
      A familiar’s color
      That familiar and everything it leads
      
        
      
      
      
      
      Moving around with the map focused
      
        
      ←↑↓→Move
      
        
      Shift←→Orbit
      
        
      +−Zoom
      
        
      0Reset the view
      
        
      TabTake Psyche’s suggested message
      
        
      EscClose, or step back out
      
      
      
      
      Display kept in this browser
      
        
      Text size
      
      
      
      
      
      
      
      
      Shape what it is
      
        
      Angular boundary
      One project. Its missions stay inside it; a quiet empty boundary is dormant
      
        
      Crown
      Psyche, at the center of each castle and of the Coven
      
        
      Seal
      A mission. Its parts and states are set out under Mission seal
      
        
      Familiar glyph
      A persistent identity. The same mark and color follow it from project to mission to agent
      
        
      Agent dot
      Filled is working, hollow is idle. A dashed place remains reserved while its agent waits at a gate. Select a mission to reveal its agents
      
        
      Dot with a second color
      An agent whose task is shared by two familiars
      
        
      Boundary square
      Pending decisions. The count includes permission requests and resource-limit requests. Open it to review
      
      
      
      
      Coven every castle at once
      
        
      Connection
      Psyche coordinates that project. Choose a familiar below the map to color its connections and highlight its missions
      
        
      Dotted connection
      No agents are assigned to that project
      
        
      Position
      Projects surround Psyche. Missions sit inside their project; familiar groups sit beside their mission. Positions stay stable during replay
      
      
      
      
      
      
      
      
      Motion what is happening
      
        
      Moving dot
      A message event in this local simulation. Lavender goes out, a familiar’s color comes back, white is a request for you
      
        
      Rising wedge
      Progress on the targets that familiar’s roles own. Everything else shares one ground plane; height does not imply authority or rank
      
      
      
      
      Mission seal one per mission
      
        
      Wedge
      One familiar on the council. Its angle is its share of the mission’s agents, its height how far the targets its roles own have come, its top bright while its agents work
      
        
      Signet
      The lavender cap in the middle. It carries the mission’s state and nothing else
      
        
      Rim
      The tightest limit: the most used of time, tokens and budget. Lavender, then coral from 85%
      
        
      Lead pip
      The dark dot on the wedge of the familiar leading the mission. Its wedge starts at twelve o’clock
